title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theater on 1972-08-21
source: Source: SBD > Master Reels @ 7.5ips (10 Inch half-track ) > PCM > DAT (44.1k) - Recorded by Betty Cantor-Jackson, provided by Charlie Miller; Transfer: Dat > Panasonic SV-3700 > Tascam DA-3000 . wav 16/44.1 - Transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick October 2017

ai_review.summary: Outstanding soundboard capture of a classic show featuring a smoking China>Rider, a dreamy Stella Blue, and a special Dark Star‑El Paso.
ai_review.review: The Miller/SirMick master tape delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality that reviewers say has never sounded better.  Musically the performance is described as vintage and in full stride, with highlights like an outstanding China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider, a melt‑into‑a‑dream Stella Blue, and a rare Dark Star → El Paso sequence.  Overall it’s hailed as a classic, high‑energy show that deserves repeated listening.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers give 5 stars and praise the performance and recording enthusiastically; limited to two reviews, so confidence is low despite strong positive signals.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller/SirMick mix described as crystal‑clear, never sounded better; no technical complaints noted.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Classic vintage performance with seamless transitions; the set is praised as firing on all cylinders from start to finish.
